candidates.statement: Payment service calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s) on every checkout trace, causing order and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502; inventory/redis calls succeed. Gateway checkout p95 ~2425ms with 16 502s/60s and zero 200s.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/logs admitted; cannot confirm whether payment is slow or unreachable. Logs excluded from budget.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated ReadTimeout on POST payment from order, propagating 502 to /v1/orders and /v1/checkout, while inventory/redis succeed. Gateway metrics confirm checkout 502s and elevated p95. Bounded to downstream payment latency/timeout; payment-side evidence not admitted.
